notes: C# rebuilt from beginner to professional for C# 14 on .NET 10: 21 new lessons and a "Working like a pro" unit (projects and MSBuild, NuGet, analyzers, xUnit, CI, web APIs, EF Core, logging, configuration, publishing)
New C# lessons on files, time zones, C# 13 and 14 features, Span<T>, attributes, source generators, calling C, channels, threads and deadlocks, secure coding, and async streams
Safer online play: other players' names, profiles, chat and duel messages can never run code in your app, and the app only runs its own scripts
Every C# exercise has tests proven to reject common wrong answers, and every lesson has a "Common mistakes" note
